website.note: Pipeline page references detalimogene (EG-70) and LEGEND trial; limited structured detail.

pipeline.modality: Non-viral gene therapy (intravesical DDX plasmid encoding RIG-I agonist + IL-12)
pipeline.target: Innate immune activation (RIG-I agonist) plus IL-12 expression

indications.indication: BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ
indications.trial_design: Open-label, multicenter Phase 1/2 study evaluating intravesical EG-70 in BCG-unresponsive and BCG-naive/incompletely treated high-risk NMIBC patients
